text: Sunset provisions fail on their own terms when the mandated reviews are not conducted thoroughly, because laws then either expire or continue without proper scrutiny, which defeats the purpose of the mechanism.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Future of Law - Dynamic Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4957318

isBasedOn.name: The Future of Law - Dynamic Web3 Governance

abstract: Moreover, if the necessary reviews are not conducted thoroughly, the effectiveness of sunset provisions is undermined, and laws may expire or continue without proper scrutiny, defeating the intended purpose of these mechanisms.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: where legislative review capacity or attention is insufficient
